author: billmac3
text:
Hi All - very interesting topic here. First I'd like to give my answer
 to the riddle of the broken FTR/FL. Price engulfed the FTR which
allowed for the high of the move which then means price can move back up
 to the FTR of the origin of the engulf which also means you shouldn't
count on that FTR/FL to hold down price since it's not the origin of the
 move! As for why Salivan chose the level to sell at, it was a LS of a
QM w/HH at #3 in Salivans chart. Sorry for the markup of the image but
my platform doesn't go back far enough!

author: billmac3
